messages:
deploy-bot: [1717008888] Initiating migration run: add_idx_event_owner_compound_v3 (canary)
mina: quick note — new validation hook constraint_check_v3 enabled for canary only. will abort on index inconsistency.
sam: canary failed with constraint_check_v3: duplicate or null keys in range shard-4 :x: 
clare: what was the backfill mode? full-table or incremental?
mina: incremental single-pass writer with upsert windows; commit frequency high to avoid long locks. suspect duplicate keys from concurrent dedupe job.
ops-oncall: saw a concurrent dedupe cron at 02:45 UTC — it overlaps canary window. that cron shouldn't run during migrations.
eng-lead: stop the canary, revert to pinned image, and re-evaluate scheduling. we can't have cron overlap.
sam: rollback command (manual):
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/schema-canary --to-revision=3
kubectl -n prod scale job/deduper-job --replicas=0
```
clare: propose next attempt plan: 1) disable dedupe cron for the migration window 2) run backfill in tenant-chunk batches (10k) with idempotent upserts 3) run constraint_check_v3 in staging with mirrored dedupe scheduled
mina: also suggest: pre-flight snapshot of owner_id uniqueness metric + quick sanity query to detect duplicates before canary.
ops-oncall: I'll enforce a migration blackout for scheduled crons and add an ops check in the deploy checklist.
eng-lead: add a temporary feature flag behind which the index is created; keep reads safe while we monitor.
clare: release notes blurb: "Canary aborted during index add: detected duplicate/null owner keys. Rescheduled with dedupe blackout, batched tenant-chunk backfill, and preflight uniqueness audit." I'll drop into release-notes draft.
deploy-bot: [1717008955] Canary rollback completed; pinned deployment to release-2026-03-09 :white_check_mark:
sam: starting manual rollback now, will post logs when done. ops-oncall: migration window paused until remediation verification.
mina: after we fix, run a dry-run with traffic replay in staging to cover dedupe overlap. no --skip-validate in prod.
eng-lead: good. assign owner: mina for backfill script, ops-oncall for blackout, clare for release notes. schedule follow-up sync in 30m.
